cohort: The study included 111 ante-partum women admitted through obstetric emergency or referred to Calcutta National Medical College and Hospital, Kolkata.
finding: Approximately 24.5% of mothers who developed pre-eclampsia had suboptimal levels of Vitamin D, suggesting a potential link between suboptimal vitamin D and pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: Among pre-eclamptic mothers, the majority (47.1%) delivered by caesarean section.
